title: REVIEW: Phase 8 — V1 Core Loop (Mission Execute + Review)
description: THE critical v1 review. A human must be able to: create a mission, start a Claude agent, see streaming output in real-time, approve an agent action, see the code diff, and approve/reject the mission. Check: (1) AgentChatPanel shows real streaming output with correct scroll-pinning, (2) AgentSwimlane reflects real agent status, (3) approval requests surface as ApprovalCards in chat AND as notification badge in nav, (4) DiffViewer renders real git diffs with correct aw.* theme override (not jarring default styling), (5) approve/reject on review page commits to server and transitions stage, (6) ContextUsageGauge shows real token counts, (7) all pages use skeleton states during load — no flash-of-nothing, (8) streaming interruption shows interrupted state not frozen cursor. Covers: bead-0054–0123 (core wiring group).

title: Timebox and define deliverable for bead-0044 (Claude Code CLI research)
description: bead-0044 is a research spike with no defined scope. Add explicit timebox: maximum 2 days. Required deliverable: docs/research/claude-code-protocol.md documenting (1) exact spawn command and flags, (2) stdout/stderr format (JSON-lines? human-readable?), (3) stdin protocol for sending follow-up messages, (4) permission prompt patterns for approval gate parsing, (5) SIGTERM/SIGINT behavior, (6) session resumption capability. If CLI is unsuitable, document MCP server approach as fallback. This ticket tracks the meta-constraint, not the research itself.

title: Research Claude Code CLI spawn protocol
description: Investigate how to spawn Claude Code (claude CLI) as a child process: what args/flags trigger agent mode, what output format it uses (JSON lines? streaming?), how to send follow-up messages, how to detect completion vs waiting-for-input. Document findings in docs/research/claude-code-protocol.md. Acceptance: document describes spawn command, output format, input protocol, completion signals.

title: Add inline agent preview panel within AppShell
description: CRITICAL: The primary job of a Mission Control operator is to monitor what AI agents are doing. Currently requires navigating to fullscreen LiveView which discards all navigation context. Create a LivePreview component that embeds a configurable subset of WorkspaceLayout (terminal + agent chat + code viewer) inside the Execute page within AppShell. Add Cmd+Shift+L keyboard shortcut to toggle it. Files: MissionExecute.tsx, WorkspaceLayout.tsx, AppShell.tsx. See docs/hci/hci-summary.md Risk 1, heuristic-evaluation.md H1 (Severity 4).
acceptance_criteria: Agent work is viewable inline from MissionExecute without leaving AppShell; Cmd+Shift+L toggles the preview; navigation context (LeftNav, TopBar, StageTabBar) remains visible
close_reason: Implemented with TDD by 5-agent team. 164 tests passing.

title: P0: Wire critical button handlers (ApprovalBar, MissionCreate, Pause/Play)
description: 3/7 core journeys dead-end at non-functional buttons. ApprovalBar approve/reject/re-plan have no onClick. MissionCreate handleCreate only toasts with no navigation. AgentChatPanel Pause/Play does nothing (sev-4 usability catastrophe). Wire mock implementations so journeys complete. Sources: Journey Map, Heuristic Eval, Cognitive Walkthrough.
close_reason: Closed

title: P0: Add ErrorBoundary wrapping Outlet in AppShell and Live View
description: No React ErrorBoundary exists in the component tree. A single runtime error crashes the entire app to a white screen. Wrap Outlet in AppShell and Live View root with ErrorBoundary showing Something went wrong plus Back to Missions link. Sources: Failure Path Audit, Heuristic Eval.
close_reason: Closed

title: P0: Add horizontal stage tab bar to all mission sub-pages
description: The four-stage lifecycle (Plan/Execute/Review/Escalation) is the core product concept but has no persistent tab bar UI. Users must scroll past 8+ sections on MissionDetail to find buried text links at the page bottom. Create a StageTabBar component and render on all mission sub-pages (MissionDetail, MissionPlan, MissionExecute, MissionReview, MissionEscalation). Sources: Cognitive Walkthrough, Info Architecture, Heuristic Eval.
close_reason: Closed

title: REVIEW: Phase 13 — Integration & E2E Tests
description: Review checkpoint after integration and E2E test suite. Check: (1) WS protocol integration tests cover all message types, (2) E2E test for start-agent → approve → complete passes in CI, (3) E2E test for full mission lifecycle passes in CI, (4) Decider and Projector unit tests hit 100% branch coverage, (5) no flaky tests, (6) CI pipeline passes fully including dependency-cruiser, (7) test coverage meets thresholds from CLAUDE.md. Covers: bead-0093–0097.

title: REVIEW: Phase 10 — Electron Distribution
description: Review checkpoint after Electron packaging. Check: (1) Electron main process spawns apps/server and waits for /health 200 before creating BrowserWindow, (2) BrowserWindow has correct security settings (contextIsolation, no nodeIntegration, correct CSP), (3) graceful app quit terminates server and all agent processes, (4) macOS DMG builds and installs cleanly, (5) app opens to correct URL in prod (built assets) and dev (vite dev server), (6) no security warnings in Electron console. Covers: bead-0073, 0076, 0081.

title: REVIEW: Phase 7 — Frontend Data Layer
description: Review checkpoint after Zustand stores and DataFacade. Check: (1) WsTransport singleton in Zustand middleware survives React tree unmounts and route transitions, (2) Zustand mission store hydrates from TanStack Query (staleTime: Infinity, no double-state), (3) DataFacade hooks are used by ALL page components — no direct data/*.ts imports remain in page files, (4) computeVerificationState moved from data/missions.ts to a utility module, (5) mock data files moved to __fixtures__ for test use only, (6) stores correctly handle WS push events for real-time updates. Covers: bead-0040, 0043, 0046, 0049, 0052, 0102.

title: REVIEW: Phase 6 — Git Integration
description: Review checkpoint after git integration. Check: (1) GitService wraps simple-git with correct error handling, (2) checkpoints create recoverable commits per agent turn, (3) rollback correctly resets to checkpoint SHA, (4) diff generation returns structured per-file diffs with hunks suitable for DiffViewer, (5) git operations don't block the Node.js event loop (use async simple-git API), (6) test with a real repo for edge cases (merge conflicts, detached HEAD, empty diffs). Covers: bead-0045, 0048, 0051, 0053.

title: REVIEW: Phase 5 — Agent Core & Approval System
description: Review checkpoint after agent spawning, streaming, and approval gate. Check: (1) Claude Code CLI spawn protocol documented with known patterns, (2) AgentExecutor interface defined with spawn/followUp/review/capabilities, (3) agent output streams without dropping chunks under load, (4) pause/resume/stop reliably affects the running process, (5) approval gate correctly detects CLI permission prompts via stdout parsing (not SDK events), (6) approval responses correctly inject y/n into stdin, (7) approval gate is infrastructure layer — not domain, (8) ApprovalCard is separate from PermissionGate (RBAC), (9) approval requests persist to approvals table. Covers: bead-0044, 0047, 0050, 0024, 0027, 0029, 0030, 0032, 0034, 0042, 0120.

title: REVIEW: Phase 4 — REST API & Server Infra
description: Review checkpoint after REST API and server infrastructure. Check: (1) all REST endpoints return correct status codes and JSON shapes, (2) health endpoint returns DB status and uptime, (3) CORS correctly restricts to expected origins, (4) graceful shutdown cleans up PTY sessions and WS clients, (5) environment config loads correctly from env vars with sensible dev defaults, (6) error responses use consistent envelope format across all endpoints, (7) stage transition endpoint enforces valid transitions and returns 422 on invalid. Covers: bead-0035, 0036, 0038, 0041, 0099, 0101, 0103, 0104.

title: REVIEW: Phase 3 — Database & Domain Layer
description: Review checkpoint after database migrations and CQRS/ES domain logic. Check: (1) SQLite running in WAL mode, (2) all tables have correct FK constraints with ON DELETE semantics, (3) all FK columns indexed, (4) Decider unit tests cover all valid/invalid transitions with expectedVersion optimistic concurrency, (5) Projector tests cover full mission lifecycle sequence, (6) event store append+replay works across server restarts, (7) mission stage FSM enforces directed transitions (plan→execute→review→escalation→completed) — no free movement, (8) escalations table exists. Covers: bead-0008–0019, 0021–0033, 0093, 0094, 0099, 0103–0108.

title: Enable SQLite WAL mode and configure pragmas on startup
description: apps/server database initialization must run: PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000; before any other queries. WAL mode is critical for concurrent reads during WS event writes. foreign_keys=ON enforces all FK constraints. busy_timeout prevents immediate failure on write contention. Acceptance: all three pragmas confirmed active on server start via PRAGMA queries.

title: REVIEW: Phase 2 — Transport Layer
description: Review checkpoint after WebSocket transport is implemented. Check: (1) wsTransport has bounded message queue, subscription replay on reconnect, and orphaned request cleanup, (2) Zod protocol schemas cover all initial message types with discriminator envelope, (3) sequence numbers on all push events, (4) heartbeat ping/pong working, (5) ConnectionStatusBanner accurately shows WS state (not browser online/offline), (6) WsTransport singleton lives in Zustand middleware NOT React context (no StrictMode double-mount risk), (7) unit tests for transport reconnection logic. Covers: bead-0016, 0018, 0020, 0022, 0025, 0109, 0110.

title: REVIEW: Phase 1 — Foundation & Architecture
description: Review checkpoint after all ADR documentation, package scaffolding, dev orchestration, and environment config is complete. Check: (1) ADR docs exist in docs/adr/ and capture actual decisions, (2) all three packages (apps/server, apps/desktop, packages/transport) scaffold cleanly with npm run dev, (3) Turborepo pipeline builds all packages, (4) ESLint/TS strict pass, (5) dev environment starts all three apps with a single command, (6) no architectural shortcuts taken. Refactor anything that deviates from CLAUDE.md architecture rules before proceeding. Covers: bead-0001–0004, 0005–0013, 0100–0101.

title: Add approval request notification badge and banner
description: When an agent emits an approval request during execution, the operator needs to know even if they're not watching the chat panel. Add: (1) a persistent notification badge on the mission's nav item in LeftNav showing pending approval count, (2) a banner in MissionExecute header 'Agent awaiting approval' with direct link to the approval card. Cleared when approval is resolved. Acceptance: approval request is visible outside the chat panel, badge shows count, resolves on decision.

title: Define AgentExecutor interface for multi-agent support
description: Create apps/server/src/agents/AgentExecutor.ts defining an interface (or abstract class) for agent executors. Methods: spawn(sessionId, workingDir, options): Promise<SpawnedAgent>, spawnFollowUp(sessionId, message): Promise<void>, spawnReview(sessionId, context): Promise<SpawnedAgent>, discoverCapabilities(): AgentCapabilities, getAvailability(): AvailabilityInfo. Types: SpawnedAgent (pid, kill(), onOutput, onExit), AgentCapabilities (supportsSessionFork, supportsReview), AvailabilityInfo (available, reason). Implement ClaudeCodeExecutor first. Acceptance: interface defined, ClaudeCodeExecutor stub implements it.

title: Create generic in-chat ApprovalCard for tool-level approvals
description: Create apps/web/src/components/execute/ApprovalCard.tsx for tool-level agent approval requests surfaced in AgentChatPanel (e.g. 'Agent wants to run: rm -rf node_modules'). Distinct from ChatPlanProposal (plan approval) and ApprovalBar (mission-level). Should show: action type, exact command/parameters, risk level (aw.accent warning tint for destructive), approve/reject buttons wired to WS approval response handler. Matches mission-control's CornerBracket + aw.* design language. Acceptance: component renders all tool-approval types, buttons dispatch correct WS messages.

title: Add scroll-pinning to AgentChatPanel
description: AgentChatPanel must pin scroll to bottom during streaming, break out when user manually scrolls up, and show a 'New messages' pill when new messages arrive while scrolled up. Clicking the pill re-pins. This prevents the jarring behavior where streaming output scrolls past the user's reading position. Acceptance: scroll-pinning works during streaming, manual scroll-up pauses it, pill appears and re-pins correctly.

title: Add sequence numbers and heartbeat to WS protocol
description: Update packages/transport/src/protocol.ts: (1) Add seq: number field to all push events for ordering guarantees -- server increments a per-channel counter. (2) Add ping/pong heartbeat message types (30s interval, 10s timeout). (3) Add a type discriminator at envelope level: { type: string, seq?: number, payload: unknown } so messages can be routed without full Zod parsing. Acceptance: all push events carry seq, WS drops detected within 40s.

title: Implement graceful shutdown in apps/server
description: Handle SIGTERM and SIGINT in apps/server: close all active PTY sessions (send SIGHUP to agent processes), close all WS client connections with code 1001, flush SQLite WAL and close DB connection, then exit(0). Without this, Electron app quit orphans agent processes. Acceptance: server shuts down cleanly within 5s of SIGTERM, no orphan processes.

title: Create DataFacade hooks for mock-to-real migration
description: Create a set of hooks in apps/web/src/hooks/data/ that abstract data source: useMissions(), useMission(id), useAgentSessions(missionId), useEvidence(missionId). Initially delegate to the static data/*.ts mock files. Gradually swap backing implementation to Zustand store / TanStack Query as backend wires up. Prevents page components from needing simultaneous mock-to-real migration. Acceptance: all page components use facade hooks, mock data still works.

title: Implement environment configuration management
description: Create apps/server/src/config.ts loading config from: environment variables, a .env file (dev), and sensible defaults. Config shape: { port: number, dbPath: string, env: 'development'|'production', agentBinaryPath: string, corsOrigins: string[] }. Expose typed config singleton. Electron injects env vars when spawning the server process. Acceptance: server reads config from env, defaults work for dev.

title: Configure dev environment orchestration for all three apps
description: Running apps/web + apps/server + apps/desktop concurrently in dev mode requires coordination. Add a root-level 'dev' npm script using concurrently (or turborepo dev pipeline) that starts: apps/server (tsx watch), apps/web (vite), and optionally apps/desktop (electron with dev server URL). Server must start before web reports ready. Acceptance: 'npm run dev' from root starts all three with correct port assignments.

title: Add GET /health server readiness endpoint
description: Implement GET /health in apps/server that returns {status:'ready', db:'connected', uptime: seconds}. The Electron main process must poll this before showing the BrowserWindow. Without it, the webview loads before the WS server is accepting connections. Acceptance: endpoint returns 200 JSON, Electron main process waits for 200 before creating BrowserWindow.

title: Write unit tests for mission Projector
description: Unit tests for apps/server/src/domain/projector.ts. Cover: empty event sequence gives initial state, each event type correctly updates state, full mission lifecycle sequence produces correct final state. Acceptance: all projection paths tested.

title: Write unit tests for mission Decider
description: Comprehensive unit tests for apps/server/src/domain/decider.ts. Cover: all valid stage transitions, all invalid transitions (expect errors), approval command on non-pending state, escalation from valid states. Use Vitest. Acceptance: 100% branch coverage of Decider logic.

title: Wire MissionReview approve/reject to real API
description: MissionReview has approve/reject buttons. Wire to: POST /api/missions/:id/approve or /reject. On approval, transition mission to completed. On rejection, allow restart from execute stage. Broadcast stage change WS event. Acceptance: review decisions persist and trigger stage transitions.

title: Wire MissionReview DiffViewer to real git diff data
description: MissionReview page shows the code diff for review. Wire to GET /api/missions/:id/diff. Pass diff data to DiffViewer component. Show per-file diffs, expandable, with line numbers. Acceptance: real code changes from agent appear in review diff.

title: Extract DiffViewer from vibe-kanban and add to apps/web
description: Read vibe-kanban's diff viewer implementation (uses @git-diff-view/react). Create apps/web/src/components/review/DiffViewer.tsx wrapping @git-diff-view/react. Match mission-control's design tokens (dark theme, typography). Replace the mock DiffByIntent component. Acceptance: component renders unified and split diffs with syntax highlighting.

title: Implement Electron main process with server lifecycle
description: apps/desktop/src/main.ts: On app start, spawn apps/server as a child process (or fork). Wait for server to be ready (HTTP health check). Create BrowserWindow loading http://localhost:{port}. On app quit, gracefully shutdown server. Acceptance: opening Electron app starts server, closing it stops server cleanly.

title: Wire start-agent flow from MissionExecute page
description: MissionExecute page needs a 'Start Agent' action that: selects working directory, selects executor, dispatches agent.start WS command to server. Server spawns agent process. Session ID returned and stored. Acceptance: clicking Start Agent spawns a real Claude Code process.

title: Wire AgentConfigPanel to real agent config and controls
description: AgentConfigPanel shows agent configuration and start/stop controls. Wire to: GET agent config, start/stop/pause controls dispatch WS messages to server, executor dropdown (Claude Code, etc). Acceptance: can configure and start an agent from the UI.

title: Wire AgentSwimlane to real agent status
description: AgentSwimlane shows agent status and step history. Subscribe to agent.status WS channel. Show: current status (planning/executing/waiting/completed), steps list with timestamps, current step highlighted. Acceptance: swimlane reflects real agent state in real time.

title: Wire AgentChatPanel to real agent WS stream
description: AgentChatPanel must show real streaming agent output. Subscribe to agent.chat.message WS channel for current session. Handle message types: text, tool-use, tool-result, thinking, error. Render each type appropriately. Acceptance: real Claude output appears in chat panel with correct formatting.

title: Wire MissionDetail page to real mission data
description: MissionDetail shows mission metadata. Wire to useMission(id) hook. Display real: title, goal, scope, risks, acceptance criteria, stage, risk tier, created date, workflow. Acceptance: real mission detail loads correctly.

title: Wire MissionHome page to real mission data
description: MissionHome (mission list) currently uses mock data. Wire to useMissions() query hook. Real missions appear in the list. Filtering by stage works. Mission cards show real data (goal, stage, risk tier, priority). Acceptance: real missions from server appear in home page.

title: Implement diff generation for review stage
description: When a mission enters review stage, generate a diff between the mission's base branch and current branch. Create apps/server/src/git/DiffGenerator.ts: getDiffForReview(repoPath, baseBranch, currentBranch) -> file-level diffs with hunks. Expose as GET /api/missions/:id/diff. Acceptance: returns structured diff data suitable for DiffViewer component. [type=task]

title: Replace mock chat data with WebSocket-backed stream
description: AgentChatPanel currently uses CANNED_RESPONSES from data/agent-chat.ts. Replace with real WS subscription to agent.chat.message channel for the current session. Messages stream in as the agent produces output. Acceptance: chat panel shows real agent output, streaming.

title: Implement agent process spawning with node-pty
description: Create apps/server/src/agents/AgentSpawner.ts. Spawns an agent process (Claude Code CLI or similar) via node-pty for PTY support. Handles: spawn with working directory + env vars, output streaming to caller, input piping, process lifecycle (running/completed/failed/killed). Acceptance: can spawn a process, stream its output, and detect completion.

title: Add TanStack Query for REST data fetching
description: Add @tanstack/react-query to apps/web. Set up QueryClient in App.tsx. Create query hooks: useMissions(), useMission(id), useMissionEvidence(id), useMissionApprovals(id), useWorkflows(). These complement the WS real-time updates. Acceptance: pages can use query hooks, data loads and caches correctly.

title: Research MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration options
description: Investigate MCP as an alternative/complement to CLI spawning: what MCP servers exist for code execution, what the protocol looks like for agent communication, whether Claude Code exposes an MCP server, how MCP compares to direct CLI spawning for our use case. Document in docs/research/mcp-options.md. Acceptance: recommendation on whether to use MCP or CLI for initial integration.

title: Create agent session store replacing data/agent-sessions.ts
description: Create apps/web/src/store/agentSessionStore.ts using Zustand. Subscribe to agent.status WS push channel. Tracks: session status, current step, steps history, output buffer. Replace data/agent-sessions.ts imports. Acceptance: AgentSwimlane shows real agent status.

title: Add simple-git to apps/server and initialize git service
description: Add simple-git dependency to apps/server. Create apps/server/src/git/GitService.ts with methods: getCurrentBranch(repoPath), getCommitHistory(repoPath, limit), getDiff(repoPath, fromRef, toRef), getStatus(repoPath). Acceptance: service returns real git data for a test repo. [type=task]

title: Create mission store with Zustand replacing data/missions.ts
description: Create apps/web/src/store/missionStore.ts using Zustand. Initial load from GET /api/missions. Subscribe to mission.stageChanged, mission.created, mission.updated WS push channels for real-time updates. Expose: missions, getMission(id), actions. Gradually replace data/missions.ts imports. Acceptance: mission list page shows real missions from server.

title: Implement PATCH /api/missions/:id/stage endpoint
description: Implement PATCH /api/missions/:id/stage. Accepts {stage: Stage} body. Runs UpdateMissionStage command through Decider. Enforces valid stage transitions. Returns updated mission or 422 with error on invalid transition. Broadcasts StageChanged WS push event. Acceptance: valid transitions succeed, invalid ones return 422.

title: Create WsContext React provider in apps/web
description: Create apps/web/src/contexts/WsContext.tsx. Wraps the WsTransport from packages/transport. Provides: connection status, typed send(), typed subscribe(channel). Wrap AppShell with WsProvider so all pages share one connection. Acceptance: all pages can access WS connection via useWs() hook.

title: Implement GET /api/missions/:id endpoint
description: Implement GET /api/missions/:id. Loads mission from event store, projects to read model. Returns 404 if not found. Acceptance: returns correct mission data.

title: Implement POST /api/missions endpoint
description: Implement POST /api/missions. Accepts CreateMission command body. Runs through Decider, persists events, returns created mission. Validate with Zod. Return 201 with created mission. Acceptance: mission persists, appears in GET /api/missions.

title: Wire PermissionGate component to real approval state
description: PermissionGate.tsx currently has no real data. Wire it to the WS agent.approval.request events. Show the pending approval (what the agent wants to do), provide approve/reject controls. Pipe decision back via WS. Acceptance: real approval requests appear in UI, user decisions reach the agent. [type=task]

title: Implement GET /api/missions endpoint
description: In apps/server/src/routes/missions.ts, implement GET /api/missions. Returns array of mission read models (projected from event store). Support query params: stage filter, workflow_id filter. Acceptance: returns correct JSON, 200 status.

title: Implement approval request/response WS handlers
description: Add WS message handlers: agent.approval.respond with {sessionId, approvalId, decision: 'approved'|'rejected', note?}. Store decision in approvals table. Emit agent.approval.resolved push event. Acceptance: frontend can send approval decisions, agent resumes or stops accordingly. [type=task]

title: Implement mission repository using event sourcing
description: Create apps/server/src/infra/MissionRepository.ts. Uses EventStore to load/save missions. load(id): replays events through Projector to get current state. save(id, command): runs Decider, appends resulting events, publishes WS push events. Acceptance: missions survive server restarts, stage transitions are recorded as events.

title: Implement approval gate in agent session
description: When an agent requests a dangerous action (detected by parsing agent output for permission prompts), pause the agent and emit an agent.approval.request WS push event. The agent session enters waiting-approval state. Resume only after approval/rejection received. Create apps/server/src/agents/ApprovalGate.ts. Acceptance: agent halts on permission request, resumes after decision. [type=feature]

title: Implement event store (append + replay)
description: Create apps/server/src/infra/EventStore.ts. Methods: append(aggregateId, events[]), loadEvents(aggregateId) -> events[], loadAllEvents() -> events[]. Uses the domain_events SQLite table. Sequences events per aggregate. Acceptance: events persist across server restarts, replay reconstructs correct state.

title: Implement mission Projector (events -> read model)
description: Create apps/server/src/domain/projector.ts. The Projector folds a sequence of events into a Mission read model. For each event type, update the relevant fields. The Projector is a pure reducer: (state, event) => state. Acceptance: unit tests verify correct state after sequences of events.

title: Implement agent pause/resume/stop controls
description: Add WS message handlers: agent.pause (send SIGSTOP to PTY), agent.resume (send SIGCONT), agent.stop (send SIGTERM then SIGKILL after timeout), agent.sendMessage (pipe text to PTY stdin). Wire to AgentChatPanel play/pause/reset controls. Acceptance: controls affect running agent process. [type=feature]

title: Implement mission Decider (command validation -> event emission)
description: Create apps/server/src/domain/decider.ts. The Decider takes (current state, command) and returns (events[] | error). Enforce invariants: can only transition stages in valid order (plan->execute->review->escalation->completed), can only approve when approval is pending, etc. Pure function - no side effects, no DB calls. Acceptance: unit tests cover all valid and invalid command/state combinations.

title: Implement agent output streaming via WebSocket
description: Wire agent PTY output -> WS push events. Create apps/server/src/agents/AgentSession.ts that manages a running agent: buffers output, emits agent.chat.message WS push events with streaming chunks, tracks agent status transitions (planning/executing/waiting-approval/completed/error). Acceptance: frontend receives streaming output in real time. [type=feature]

title: Create useWebSocket React hook in apps/web
description: Create apps/web/src/hooks/useWebSocket.ts wrapping WsTransport from packages/transport. Provides: connection status, send(request), subscribe(channel, handler), automatic reconnection. Expose via React context (WsContext) so all components share one connection. Acceptance: hook connects to local server, ConnectionStatusBanner shows real state.

title: Define mission domain event types
description: In apps/server/src/domain/events.ts, define Zod schemas for domain events emitted by the mission aggregate: MissionCreated, StageChanged, AgentSessionStarted, AgentSessionCompleted, ApprovalRequested, ApprovalResolved, EvidenceAdded, EscalationRaised, EscalationResolved. Acceptance: all events compile, Zod validated.

title: Define mission command types
description: In apps/server/src/domain/commands.ts, define Zod schemas for all mission commands: CreateMission, UpdateMissionStage, AddEvidence, RequestApproval, ResolveApproval, RaiseEscalation, ResolveEscalation, AssignAgent, CompleteAgent. Each command has: id, type, payload, issued_at, issued_by. Acceptance: all types compile, Zod validated.

title: Implement WebSocket server handler in apps/server
description: Create apps/server/src/ws/WsServer.ts. Use the 'ws' npm package. Handle: client connection/disconnection, message routing to registered handlers, push event broadcast to subscribed clients, request/response correlation matching client's WsTransport. Register handlers for initial message types defined in protocol. Acceptance: server handles connect/disconnect, routes messages, broadcasts pushes.

title: Define WebSocket protocol message types with Zod
description: In packages/transport/src/protocol.ts, define the full WS protocol using Zod schemas. Include: BaseRequest (id, type, body), BaseResponse (id, type, result/error), PushEvent (channel, event, payload). Define initial message types: ping/pong, mission.list, mission.get, mission.stageTransition, agent.status, agent.chat.message, agent.approval.request, agent.approval.response. Acceptance: all types exported, validated with Zod, TypeScript types inferred correctly.

title: Create approvals table migration
description: Create 005_approvals.sql migration. Schema: id, agent_session_id (FK), mission_id (FK), request_type (tool-use/file-write/command/other), request_payload (JSON), status (pending/approved/rejected), decided_by, decided_at, created_at. Acceptance: migration runs.

title: Port wsTransport.ts from t3code to packages/transport
description: Read t3code's apps/web/src/wsTransport.ts (https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code) and port it to packages/transport/src/WsTransport.ts. Remove all Effect dependencies. Replace with plain TypeScript. Keep: reconnection with exponential backoff (500ms-8s), message queuing during disconnect, typed channel subscriptions, request/response correlation with timeouts. Use Zod for message validation instead of Effect Schema. Acceptance: unit tests pass, no Effect imports.

title: Create domain events table migration (event store)
description: Create 003_events.sql migration for append-only event store. Schema: id (text PK), aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload (JSON), sequence_number (integer), occurred_at. Index on (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, sequence_number). Acceptance: migration runs, append-only by convention.

title: Create agent_sessions table migration
description: Create 002_agent_sessions.sql migration. Schema: id (text PK), mission_id (FK), executor (enum: claude-code, codex, etc), status (idle/planning/executing/waiting-approval/error/completed), working_dir, branch, created_at, updated_at. Acceptance: migration runs.

title: Create missions table migration
description: Create 001_missions.sql migration. Schema: id (text PK), title, goal, scope, stage (enum), risk_tier, priority, status, created_at, updated_at, blocked_by (JSON array of IDs), blocks (JSON array of IDs), workflow_id, tags (JSON). Acceptance: migration runs, table created with correct schema.

title: Set up SQLite database in apps/server with better-sqlite3
description: Add better-sqlite3 (synchronous SQLite) to apps/server. Create src/db/database.ts with connection setup, WAL mode, foreign keys enabled.
